newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius index eases, share prices in thin ranges.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius index eases, share prices in thin ranges.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Mauritius share index semdex eased by 0.10 points to 367.77 on Wednesday as stock prices remained in tight ranges in a market which requires fresh impetus, dealers said.
Turnover was posted at 16.88 million rupees on 744,279 shares from 15.92 million rupees on 476,592 shares on Monday.
Dealers attributed the higher-than-average volume to foreign investor trading in leading stocks such as New Mauritius Hotels, Mauritius Commercial Bank, State Bank of Mauritius.
"Apart from that (foreign investor trading), shares of the smaller companies were mostly on the downside but by thin margins," one dealer said.
The dealer added that the absence of a general trend reflected a market looking for fresh news.

"What we are seeing now is a two-fold market, foreigners buying the leading stocks and the smaller capitalised companies left on their own and in which the locals are principally active," the dealer said.
Mauritius Commercial Bank was unchanged at 86 rupees on 41,882 shares and State Bank of Mauritius remained at 11.10 rupees on 178,400 shares.
Hotel concerns Sun Resorts gained 20 cents to 41.70 rupees on 31,076 shares and New Mauritius Hotels was unchanged at 34 rupees on a heavy 116,417 shares.
British American Insurance crawled up by five cents to 8.05 rupees on 106,890 shares and Mauritius Breweries jumped 5.0 rupees to 138 on 3,198 shares.
Investment-based Promotion And Development (PAD) was down 20 cents to 16 rupees on 28,916 shares and National Investment Trust (NIT) lost 10 cents to 12.80 rupees on 13,050 shares.
Sugar stocks Mon Tresor Mon Desert was stable at 38.10 rupees on 16,838 shares and Savannah (ordinary) slumped by 4.0 rupees to 135 on 588 shares.
Commerce-based Rogers remained at 100 rupees on 2,985 shares, Happy World Foods gained 20 cents to 16.50 rupees on 125,199 shares and Courts dived by 20 cents to 5.40 rupees on 13,000 shares.
Shell (Mauritius) shed 30 cents to 15.60 rupees on 6,000 shares and national carrier Air Mauritius was unchanged at 44 rupees on 1,990 shares.
